---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any alternative approaches?

## Use Case
Describe a specific scenario where this feature would be useful.

## Implementation Ideas
If you have technical ideas on how to implement this, please share.

## Related Features
Are there any existing features this would integrate with?

## Priority
- [ ] Critical - Platform is unusable without this
- [ ] High - Significantly improves functionality
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor enhancement

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.
